correctness.rationale: All quantifiers and boundary cases are explicit (n>=4, J>0, gamma>0, arbitrary real detuning and any mixed initial state). The excitation Lyapunov derivative makes every stationary state dark, and the absence of all excited dark eigenvectors guarantees global convergence by finite-dimensional invariance. The Jordan--Wigner closing-edge sign (-1)^(p-1) is verified from the spin-sector matrices. The exterior-power annihilation lemma handles arbitrary spectral degeneracies. Exact Chebyshev continuant equations lead to the odd-k resonances, with a separate delta=0 construction. Nonzero delta yields at most one dark orbital in either parity sector, excluding dark states for p>=2. Actual package code passed VERIFY_OK 369; finite enumeration is explicitly not an infinite proof.

value.rationale: A cycle with a single sink is the smallest natural non-zero-forcing cooling geometry, where the prior graph sufficient criterion is silent. The theorem resolves the complete detuning axis for all cycle lengths and all particle sectors, not just a numerical sample. The distinction between physical odd-k exceptions and spurious antiperiodic even-k one-body modes clarifies a genuine fermion-parity obstruction that cannot be inferred from testing one sign of the one-body matrix. The result supplies exact local-field designs and failure resonances without pretending to determine convergence speed.
